verdict.rationale: v0's own deployment is documented only as one-click deploys to Vercel infrastructure. The product does let you take the generated code out: you can push it directly to your own GitHub repository, and the API lists export capabilities for migration. That makes running it on an external host or your own servers possible, but the deployment itself is not a documented v0 feature. Missing for 10: documented deployment to non-Vercel hosts or self-managed infrastructure, a self-hosting or export guide, and hands-on corroboration of running v0 apps off-Vercel.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the generated app to an external host or my own infrastructure

citations.quote: Connect to GitHub and push code directly to your repository.
Export capabilities for backup and migration
Connect a v0 project to GitHub to keep its code in a repository
